newsitem.title: USA: Hilton extends deadline for tender offers.
newsitem.headline: Hilton extends deadline for tender offers.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp Thursday said it extended the deadlines for its previously announced tender offers and consent solicitations for its proposed merger with Bally Entertainment Corp.

In a statement, Hilton said the deadline was extended until the the earlier of 1700 EST/2200 GMT on the next business day following the close of its merger with Bally Entertainment or or 1200 EST/1700 GMT December 20. The move applies to certain issues of notes of Bally's wholly owned subsidiaries and for the first mortgage notes of Bally's Grand Inc, an 85 percent-owned subsidiary of Bally.

Hilton said the new deadlines for the tender offers and consent solicitations are based on Hilton's current expectations as to when its pending merger will close and are subject to change. Hilton also said, as of the close of business Wednesday, Hilton had received more than 90 percent of the requisite consents for each issue of notes.

The tender offers and consent solicitations are part of the refinancing related to Hilton's pending merger with Bally and are contingent upon, among other things, closing of the merger. The completion of the merger is not contingent upon the close of the tender offers.
